risks.title: Cybersecurity and cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 1A with a detailed governance framework (CIO, certified SDIS, Board oversight). The language indicates high vigilance, including annual Board updates and integration into the ERM program. Cybersecurity category is critical for an IT company. High weighting.

risks.title: Litigation related to construction products
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions recurring litigation in the construction sector, including an arbitration settled for $24.7M in March 2025. A cost of $9.4M was recorded in Q4 2025. The language shows a material past impact, and the risk is recurring. Litigation category with maximum severity due to financial magnitude and potential existential nature.

risks.title: Dependence on construction markets
risks.score_rationale: Volume decline in the Architectural Glass and Metals segments is attributed to reduced demand. This direct link between performance and the building cycle is a structural risk. Although not explicitly stated in Item 1A, it is inferred from MD&A comments on declining revenues. Industrial category reflecting sector dependence. Descriptive but implicit language.

risks.title: High aluminum and insurance costs
risks.score_rationale: The MD&A explicitly cites rising aluminum and healthcare insurance costs as margin pressures on gross margin. These factors are recurring and significant (direct impact on profitability). Although not listed in Item 1A, they are clearly identified as major operational risks in the financial analysis. Justified Industrial category.

risks.title: Integration of the UW Solutions acquisition
risks.score_rationale: The $240.9M acquisition of UW Solutions is recent (Nov. 2024). The text mentions increased amortization and cost impact. Although not explicitly stated as a risk in Item 1A, integration risk is implicit. Capital category to reflect financial and strategic risk. Indirect language but verified context.
